headline: Intel wins FCC waiver to keep using foreign-made robots at chip fabs
summary: Intel asked the FCC for a waiver from a ban on foreign-made robots, warning it could not maintain automated guided vehicles it called crucial to US chip production. The FCC granted the waiver, resolving Intel's concern that the ban's fuzzy scope could hit its fabs.
